major_cooldowns.name: Dream Breath
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it right after you consume your Echo buffs so it does not eat them, at rank 1 when damage is light and rank 3 when you need a burst heal.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 355936 is the empower cast; 355941 and 376788 are the Dream Breath auras.

major_cooldowns.name: Fire Breath
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it at rank 3 whenever it is up for the large area damage and the party healing that rides along with it.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 357208 is the empower cast; 357209 is the enemy debuff, 1283718 and 1283719 are unobserved twins.

major_cooldowns.name: Stasis
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Plan it ahead, store one Temporal Anomaly and at least one Dream Breath, then release the pack into a damage event you know is coming.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 370537 is the store cast; 370564 is the release cast and 370562 the stored aura.

major_cooldowns.name: Tip the Scales
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it before an empowered cast so Dream Breath or Fire Breath goes out instantly at max rank, and as Chronowarden line it up with Stasis.

major_cooldowns.name: Dream Flight
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Fly it across a stacked group every time it is up, and keep casting Emerald Blossom through the Inner Flame window it opens.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 359816 is not pressed in the sampled parses but is castable per its tooltip, and the guide gives it a full section.

major_cooldowns.name: Rewind
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Save it for the fight's most dangerous moment and press it right after the hit lands, since it heals back a share of the last 5 seconds of damage.

defensives.name: Obsidian Scales
defensives.usage_rule: Press it before a hit aimed at you to cut the damage by 30% and heal back what it prevents through Renewing Blaze.

defensives.name: Zephyr
defensives.usage_rule: Press it just before area damage lands to cut it by 20% for you and the four nearest allies.

defensives.name: Time Dilation
defensives.usage_rule: Put it on whoever is about to take a big hit and use it often, since half of that damage is spread over 8 seconds instead.

defensives.name: Cauterizing Flame
defensives.usage_rule: Press it to strip a harmful effect for a free heal, and store three inside Stasis when the whole group needs cleansing.
defensives.id_note: 374251 is not pressed in the sampled parses but is castable per its tooltip.

rules.description: Spend every Essence Burst before it falls off
rules.action: Dump it into Echo, or into Emerald Blossom while Twin Echoes still has room.

rules.description: Emerald Blossom never at capped Twin Echoes
rules.action: Press Echo once Twin Echoes is capped and blossom again after the stacks are spent.

rules.description: Store Temporal Anomaly inside every Stasis
rules.action: Follow the store with a Temporal Anomaly and a Dream Breath, then release into planned damage.

rules.description: Keep Reversion up between Temporal Anomalies
rules.action: Follow each Temporal Anomaly with Reversion so the heal over time never lapses.

rules.description: Blessing of the Bronze up for the whole pull
rules.action: Cast it before you pull so the raid buff covers the whole fight.
